items.title: Ruth Brown interviewed by Michael Woods, Scottsdale, Arizona, March 4, 1995
items.q: And I like some of the things that BeBe and CeCe Winans are doing.

ctx.x: One last thing I would like to ask you. Who is coming up on the scene now as young R&B artists, that you think has their thumb on the pulse of great traditions.

Well I’ll tell you there’s a fine line now. A lot of the people that are being categorized as R&B singers, I don’t know. The category is strange and different now, you know? But I tell you, I admire Oleta Adams, wherever she’s been, I like her. I’ve heard some things by Toni Braxton, I like her a little bit. And I always slide back into Aretha on some things she just refuses to go away I say. When she’s right she’s just right. But there are a lot of the new artists that I’m not familiar with.
